values: Local source workbook dated 2026-09-13. Snapshot prepared 2026-09-14.
Google authentication/network request failed. This file is not a PostgreSQL export or confirmation of deployed data.
Corrected columns begin with current values. Edit them, set Decision, and add a note. Grey/current columns preserve the source.
Match stable IDs and source row
Copy approved corrections into the original named Google Sheet tab. This review file is not directly imported by the application.
Agree family placement and specialty labels before product exceptions, variants and supplier prices.
Product names, family membership and visibility. Missing/blank active means true. False excludes discovery.
Supplier SKU, brand, UOM, stock and lead time. Product-level SKU/UOM are not the offer source.
One row per tier. Preserve currency and UOM; compare like packs. Correct missing IDs before sync.
page/position/category_id/department are imported from parent_products. parent_name is review-only; approved product_families.name controls runtime names.
CATEGORY nodes lead to SPECIALTY children. Four specialties per message, up to twelve parent families.
These are proposed review rows. Map into product_attributes with an approved taxonomy version before the bot uses them.
Existing _review_reason text is copied as evidence; its statements about old code may now be outdated.
browse_memberships, offer_lines, family_offers, featured_products, family_dict and product_attributes_review remain outside direct imports.
No source values, prices or placement have been changed in Google Sheets or PostgreSQL.
Check skipped-invalid rows and version history before activating corrections. A dry run rolls back everything.
Use deployed exchange-rate settings. New pricing.currency defaults to UGX when blank/missing.
